description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing projects within a backend service using FastAPI. It includes functions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting projects, as well as managing project members and fetching project statistics.

methods.name: list_projects( page: int = Query(1, ge=1), per_page: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search by project name"), status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by status"), current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of projects accessible to the current user, with optional search and status filters.

methods.name: get_project( project_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific project by ID, including statistics and member info.

methods.name: create_project( project_data: ProjectCreate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(require_role(UserRole.PROJECT_MANAGER)), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Creates a new project and adds the creator as a member with owner role, logs activity.

methods.name: update_project( project_id: str, project_data: ProjectUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Updates existing project details if the user is owner or admin, logs the update activity.

methods.name: delete_project( project_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Deletes a project and related data if user is owner or admin, logs deletion activity.

methods.name: get_project_members( project_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Returns a list of all members associated with a specific project.

methods.name: add_project_member( project_id: str, user_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Adds a user as a member to a project, with permission checks and activity logging.

methods.name: remove_project_member( project_id: str, user_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Removes a user from a project, with permission checks, cannot remove owner, logs activity.

methods.name: get_project_stats( project_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Provides project statistics including bug counts by status and priority.
